title: 1BR Foothill Hidden Fees Trap
address: 1640 Foothill Blvd, Apt 12, San Luis Obispo, CA 93405
description_and_lease_text: Attractive 1BR apartment 1.4 miles from Cal Poly. Base rent is $1,795 but tenant pays all utilities separately (water/sewer, trash, electricity/gas, internet not included). Mandatory covered parking fee of $95/month applies. In-unit washer/dryer and dishwasher. Subleasing allowed with written approval. Pets allowed.
